metadata.description: Scheduled analytics rules for Herr Ober. Sentinel must be enabled on the workspace.

properties.description: Any high-severity finding raised by ober watch (L1 rules).
properties.query:
OberFindings_CL
| where ingestion_time() between (ago(5m) .. now())
| where severity == "high"
| project TimeGenerated, finding_id, rule, severity, client_ip, access_key, bucket, node, window_s, detail, action

properties.displayName: Herr Ober: same IP triggered 3 or more distinct rules within 1h
properties.description: One client IP triggered three or more distinct ober watch rules within an hour (multi-stage attacker). ober watch dedupes findings per IP across nodes, so the signal is rule diversity, not node count. Only fires when a new finding for the IP was ingested in the last 15 minutes, so overlapping lookbacks do not raise duplicate incidents.
properties.query:
OberFindings_CL
| where isnotempty(client_ip)
| summarize TimeGenerated = max(TimeGenerated), last_ingest = max(ingestion_time()), first_seen = min(TimeGenerated),
            rules = make_set(rule), rule_count = dcount(rule), nodes = make_set(node),
            access_key = take_any(access_key), bucket = take_any(bucket), findings = count() by client_ip
| where rule_count >= 3 and last_ingest > ago(15m)
| extend rule = "multi_stage_ip", node = tostring(nodes[0])

properties.displayName: Herr Ober: access key used from more than 20 IPs in one window
properties.description: A single S3 access key was used from more than 20 distinct client IPs in one summary window (credential sharing or leak).
properties.query:
OberKeySummary_CL
| where ingestion_time() between (ago(5m) .. now())
| where isnotempty(access_key) and access_key !in (\"(heartbeat)\", \"(failed-keys)\", \"(overflow)\") and distinct_ips > 20
| extend rule = "key_many_ips", node = tostring(nodes[0])
| project TimeGenerated, access_key, distinct_ips, requests, auth_failures, internet_requests, window_s, nodes, node, rule

properties.displayName: Herr Ober: egress spike per access key
properties.description: Bytes out in the last hour exceed 5x the key's 14-day hourly average and 50 GiB.
properties.query:
let baseline_hours = 14d / 1h - 1;
let baseline = OberKeySummary_CL
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(14d) .. ago(1h))
| where isnotempty(access_key) and access_key !in ("(heartbeat)", "(failed-keys)", "(overflow)")
| summarize baseline_bytes = sum(bytes_out) by access_key
| extend avg_hourly_bytes = todouble(baseline_bytes) / baseline_hours;
OberKeySummary_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where isnotempty(access_key) and access_key !in ("(heartbeat)", "(failed-keys)", "(overflow)")
| summarize TimeGenerated = max(TimeGenerated), bytes_out_1h = sum(bytes_out),
            distinct_ips = max(distinct_ips), node_lists = make_list(nodes), last_ingest = max(ingestion_time()) by access_key
| join kind=leftouter baseline on access_key
| extend avg_hourly_bytes = coalesce(avg_hourly_bytes, 0.0)
| where last_ingest > ago(30m)
| where bytes_out_1h > 50.0 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 and bytes_out_1h > 5 * avg_hourly_bytes
| extend rule = "egress_spike", node = tostring(node_lists[0][0])
| project TimeGenerated, access_key, bytes_out_1h, avg_hourly_bytes, distinct_ips, node, rule

properties.displayName: Herr Ober: no key summaries received for 30 minutes
properties.description: No OberKeySummary_CL rows (not even the (heartbeat) row ober watch sends every interval) arrived for 30 minutes: ober watch or the ingestion path is down.
properties.query:
OberKeySummary_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30m)
| summarize rows = count()
| where rows == 0
| extend TimeGenerated = now(), rule = "summary_health"

properties.displayName: Herr Ober: proxies report zero requests for 60 minutes during business hours
properties.description: Every heartbeat row in the window reports requests == 0 during business hours, so the proxies probably stopped sending logs to ober watch (syslog path broken). Informational. Adjust the let statements (window, business hours in UTC, weekdays) in the query.
